meta.summary: Step 14 evaluated workflow capability, data quality, gate correctness, risk propagation, and issue attribution. Because there is only one completed demo case and several metrics are mock, estimated, or not available, the overall evaluation status is needs_review rather than pass.

evaluates: Agent workflow completion and artifact structure
Planner routing and downstream handoff quality
Brand Compliance risk detection and blocked gate propagation
Human Approval inheritance and release gate correctness
Metric data availability and source classification
Failure taxonomy, issue attribution, and iteration recommendations

data_source_type_rules.measured: Supported by current artifact presence, JSON validation, explicit release gate values, or counted records in current files.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Required proof, authorization, Brief field, or sample data is missing.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: Proof and asset authorization remain missing.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Planner routes nodes in an unsafe or dependency-violating order.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: No current routing error found; keep monitoring Image Prompt placement after approval.

failure_taxonomy.definition: A claim lacks Brief, proof, or upstream evidence.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: Technical/performance and AI editing claims require evidence before final generation.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Risk identified upstream is not inherited by downstream gates.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: No critical propagation failure found; release gates are inherited.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Blocked compliance item is incorrectly allowed into final generation or public release.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: No current gate failure found; gates remain blocked.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Human approval is missing, fabricated, or ignored.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: No fabricated reviewer details; real approval remains pending.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Required JSON or Markdown artifact is missing or invalid.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: Step 14 JSON must be validated after generation.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Claim, risk, or decision cannot be traced to upstream artifacts.
failure_taxonomy.current_observation: Traceability exists at artifact level; field-level trace matrix is incomplete.

failure_taxonomy.definition: Too few benchmark cases or annotations to support stable conclusions.
